description: Plugin-bundled Codex hooks: four capacity-driven PostToolUse hooks that measure context fill from the transcript and inject one short instruction for the agent to act on over its OWN Speqq MCP connection - read the product brief (read-product-context) and the active spec's memory (read-memory) when the window is near-empty, append a progress note to memory as it fills (append-memory), and prefer the Speqq knowledge graph over filesystem search (prefer-knowledge-graph). Tokenless: no hook opens an MCP connection, resolves credentials, or makes a network call. Loaded automatically with the spec-kit plugin; Codex trust-gates plugin hooks - review with /hooks once after install and re-trust after any change. Tested on Codex 0.147.0.
